verses.en: By the fig, by the olive,
We create man in the finest state
verses.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ

verses.en: then reduce him to the lowest of the low,
except those who believe and do good deeds–– they will have an unfailing reward.
verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

verses.en: After this, what makes you [man] deny the Judgement?
Is God not the most decisive of judges?
